result.keyword: What's the best payment processor for a small online store?
result.markdown:
For a small online store, my top recommendation would be **Stripe**, unless you're already using Shopify, in which case I'd choose **Shopify Payments**\.

If you're operating in Australia, there are four providers I'd seriously consider.

## Best payment processors for a small Australian online store

![Stripe Conversion Tracking – Able Customer Data Platform](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/uLblf37t9qmSgXH90IIrfyM1cEVlAyfeKTR0KIuJzNcMC_B2ZUJW9p7BftOV-yzXikVmn2jDYU_Zq1ExkRO0GTjHIMaYqcU4RzMNo1YrpDxk3GXGSNzey-FFdr644M2DVq4UsY3Zo9OE1wDfp2BQqWf9beRf_8lKhubJp-AjxGHf8Zwil7Ew0fyQc0BJ2PlA?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Stripe**

(Best overall)

- Australian domestic cards: approximately 1.65% + \$0.30
- No standard monthly processing fee
- Excellent integrations and reporting
- Apple Pay, Google Pay and international payments

Best for flexibility and growing online businesses.

[Stripe Australia](https://stripe.com/au)

---

![Shopify Payments w Polsce – jak działa, koszty, wdrożenie, zalety - Adtrip](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/tzlxg0Y9z5dRoMa7puRQ5gUF-G3hcQ7FEcuVco38BEG917LKXepufVl9cw-FwTKDdqoHqkcHNs202c43Bsg-KXxlvnrYPNEJMBSIYJqLREQ2DlgIvAOQgkKyUCOU_zdRd59gIwC2e-5cs0YCLvv_6mYa-9FiK4qFkvvkawoheALPlNv3AkWQkvUMElw-UVk8?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Shopify Payments**

(Best for Shopify stores)

- Integrated directly into Shopify
- No separate payment gateway required
- Simplifies refunds and order management
- Supports major cards and digital wallets

Best if your store is built on Shopify.

[Shopify Payments Australia](https://www.shopify.com/au/payments)

---

![Download the PayPal logo in PNG y SVG | LogosDown](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/MAzkiJ1YuDnyj2FyYAyszlEHA_k7S0XqFuDRhbVDc0cICTj1-X82VJgt7N8vcRcKsONlo3HvF0Pe2MUizAJnEXGjXwhkQKSdT9w8dASkeKU2hONBc_K0UGh46cKL9ey1QEsmTJtnMOjwtp9k8flMfotUdye-2o09Vcb_X37Fr_RqbfMx2vNQ-Z2QRLli3zQI?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. PayPal**

- Widely recognised by customers
- Familiar checkout experience
- Offers PayPal wallet payments
- Useful as an additional payment option

Best as a secondary checkout option alongside Stripe.

[PayPal Australia Business](https://www.paypal.com/au/business)

---

![Airwallex Logo Vector PNG | Modern Global Payments Brand Icon  - freepng](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/cFbGTguMuX4NolZbruyR2e9UuMWzIcApce9GwnB52sKTkNYR004hxhoF8Ij9azaRbMXEJgKRHsclL3c7QjB8TJjaOTDcrg4k3A5inD7vzblx0d1z3hgdBOQOwY04EZUWK2_K2j2_0mXQsLUCmgN2eSvYqOiDe6vtcOsjp3z8pqXOq4rreZAlQfF7YiTD92T7?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Airwallex**

- Australian domestic cards: approximately 1.65% + \$0.30
- Competitive international payment options
- Multi-currency accounts
- Useful international settlement capabilities

Best if you plan to sell internationally.

[Airwallex Australia](https://www.airwallex.com/au)

Indicative Australian pricing; confirm current rates, GST treatment and eligibility before signing up. [www.airwallex.com](https://www.airwallex.com/en-au/blog/ecommerce-payment-solutions-providers?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.shopify.com](https://www.shopify.com/au/blog/payment-processing-for-small-business?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## My recommendation

For a typical small online store\:

| Requirement | My choice |
|--------|--------|
| Best all-rounder | Stripe |
| Shopify website | Shopify Payments |
| International customers | Airwallex |
| Additional customer payment choice | PayPal |


I'd generally start with Stripe or Shopify Payments and add PayPal as an alternative.
